content.comment_body: I'm using the latest version of [product_name] but can't figure out how to configure a push button with my [product_name] [version_no]. I've set up a network input switch, but I'm unable to make it work as a push button. Does anyone know how this can be done?

[product_name] [version_no] supports a push button function. You can choose between two options: 'Click' for a high signal pulse only, or 'Hold', which keeps the variable at a high signal as long as the mouse button is pressed.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulties locating and configuring the push button feature in [product_name] while using [product_name] [version_no]. The distinction between network input switches and push button settings is unclear, pointing to issues with interface design and clarity for basic control features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the push button configuration in [product_name] to be straightforward for [product_name] [version_no], with clear settings for both momentary ('click') and continuous ('hold') functions.
